keyFindings.summary: .db-numeric-value stamped with no CSS rule — parity-by-accident with Notion's left-aligned numbers (a9f53856); needs a deliberate rule or a documented hook.
Add-row label follows source noun in Notion (19745d87 vs e33466b4); ours fixed t(toolbar.new) at table-renderer.ts:982; noun-source is a product decision.
Column-type set missing Person/URL/Email/Phone + audit types vs Notion's 16 (af7a18b0); additive union + glyph extension; audit types ride row.computed.
Create-on-type inside the table option editor unverified (cell-editor-option.ts beyond bounded list); 050 ADR-007's no-oninput facts stand as guards.
Digest open question #1 closed: multi-select chips inline (21d71e5f parity) with per-chip remove; measurer sizes for badges+4px gaps cap 560.
Freeze is per-column-action shape (not always-on sticky title) and desktop-only by construction (phone auto layout, styles.css:20914-20921); iOS sticky visual stays device-only.
Header row w/ type icon+label+menu target, in-header sort ordinal, add-column +, grouped type submenu — at parity or ahead; convert to regression guards.
Hover unobservable in the digest (§6 Q5); no Notion-derived change; ours judged on its own contrast bar.
Notion date picker carries End date (bd482935); ours has none (cell-editor-date.ts read). Optional end-date value + picker row + range display; Timezone/Remind rejected as non-portable.
Notion per-column Freeze action (74fe28d3, 039351aa) absent here; ViewConfig.frozenColumnKeys + ColumnMenuActions.freezeColumn + sticky th/td CSS; red-first: 0 freeze matches today (digest §4 P7).
Notion's muted literal Empty (050083af) is page-view-only; our table cells already blank-match; adopt the word placeholder in the docked peek only.

P10 view toggles: 4 of 6 have analogues (record icon, wrapText, load limit, open-target); Show-vertical-lines is a small additive (drop td border-right via container class); data-source-title unverified, deferred.

P9 conditional row colour ALREADY SHIPS: applyConditionalFormat sets --db-conditional-format-bg on tr (conditional-formatting.ts:168-206; table-renderer.ts:85/866/911) and tr.db-conditional-format>td paints it (styles.css:1317-1319). Digest §4 P9 'no match' was a grep miss. Residue: naming/discoverability only.
Per-column Calculate footer at parity (6055725d, 101392c7); zero-row guard + 44px phone floor are ADR-005 landed; pin as guards.
Phone pickers as bottom sheets / inline docks match P12 grammar; column-width adjuster rides the shared sheet host.
Property visibility panel at parity (9867cb76) incl. disabled-title-eye convention; title-eye state itself is verification debt.

Q4: no candidate conflicts with a landed ruling; table is governed by item-wise adoption (050 ADR-006, §6A ~22:45), not whole-view parity. Four tensions named (title-menu convention, wrap, conditional-colour naming, contrast guardrail).
Q5: freeze sticky visual on iOS; 390px title-affordance composition; dark theme for every new colour (0 dark captures in harvest, digest §6 Q6); hover carries no Notion claim.

Q6: five phases — A guards on already-haves (A1-A5, negative-control red-first), B the committed wrap defect (T016), C freeze (top adoption, desktop-only), D quality batch (D1 end-range, D2 type scaffolding, D3 handle visibility, D4 vertical-lines, D5 peek Empty, D6 noun label), E verification debts + operator questions.
Resize handle discoverability: visible 2px accent line on th:hover at styles.css:5656-5664; precision panel/auto-fit already exceed captures.
Row expand triangle (90277769) deliberately not adopted — record-open affordance + peek/sheet already own the need.
Selection column + range select + group indeterminate ahead of Notion's captures; keep and guard.
Status pill recolours per option (8d6dcf3b, 6673816d) — renderStatus stamps per-option color class.
Title-cell open affordance vs Notion's overlapping OPEN pill (19745d87, 35c64a84): 390px composition unmeasured; phase task defines threshold + red-first.
Title-menu Hide/Delete: Notion omits, we disable — recorded convention equivalence, keep ours.
Wrap two-level control shape confirmed by Notion P8; the wrap-off tall-row defect is ours (T016 leg) and lands at the escaping element.
